outcome: Histological changes in placenta (Syncytial knots, cytotrophoblast proliferation, basement membrane thickness)
cohort: The participants were 120 women, 60 normotensive and 60 pre-eclamptic, from whom placentae were collected after birth.
finding: There is a strong positive association between serum Vitamin-D levels, placental laminin expression, and the severity of histopathological changes observed in placentae of pre-eclamptic women compared to normotensive women.
